python3 << 'EOF'
# Data for matured noninterest-bearing debt (fiscal years 1960-1967)
data = {
    1960: 280,
    1961: 240,
    1962: 211,
    1963: 157,
    1964: 139,
    1965: 110,
    1966: 95,
    1967: 88
}

alpha = 0.4

# Single exponential smoothing
# Initialize with first value
years = sorted(data.keys())
values = [data[y] for y in years]

# S_0 (first smoothed value) = first actual value
smoothed = [values[0]]
print(f"Year {years[0]}: Actual = {values[0]}, Smoothed = {smoothed[0]}")

# Apply single exponential smoothing for each subsequent year
for i in range(1, len(values)):
    s = alpha * values[i] + (1 - alpha) * smoothed[i-1]
    smoothed.append(s)
    print(f"Year {years[i]}: Actual = {values[i]}, Smoothed = {s}")

# The forecast for 1968 is the smoothed value for 1967
forecast_1968 = smoothed[-1]
print(f"\nForecast for 1968 (smoothed value for 1967): {forecast_1968}")
print(f"Rounded to 2 decimal places: {round(forecast_1968, 2)}")
EOF
